verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state directly that users can view account numbers anytime under Accounts → Account Details and can generate a bank verification letter from the same screen. Relay-docs-32 separately confirms that account and routing numbers exist and can be printed on third-party checks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the verification-letter feature, and explicit confirmation that finance-lead roles (not just owners) can access these details.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime

citations.quote: Go to Accounts → Account Details in the Relay app to view your numbers anytime, or generate a bank verification letter from the same screen.
Print third-party check books with your Relay account and routing number
